evidence.result: Parsed 146 frozen input articles and all 19 review files (60 verdict records). Exactly 60 have verdict=accept and an article_sha256 equal to the independently recomputed canonical article JSON hash. The generated asset contains exactly those 60 IDs, sorted and unique; no unexpected IDs and no missing accepted IDs.

Asset schema qm-question-articles/v1; all 60 entries status=accepted; deep equality holds against the locally recomputed expected export consisting of each exact accepted frozen object with status changed from draft to accepted. Canonical asset SHA-256: 3752e4177f960e25380b2095aa9223a2bc12af9b259f5b7fc3dda764b6101984. Canonical sorted [id, reviewed article_sha256] manifest digest: 71501a9498df52a141aba999b21e8597f0c34e13697e0f9ae1a12368d390553f.

The exporter subset is deliberate: 86 of the 146 frozen draft objects have no accepted review and are absent from the asset (60 target-only and 26 question-bound). No unreviewed object is included. Published bindings total 50 target_refs and 10 exact question_refs.

build.py requires independent top-level review identities, exact reviewed canonical hash, valid accepted/draft input status, 2–5 unique HTTPS sources with evidence metadata, nonempty Russian title/body, target catalog membership or exact question revision, and unique bindings; it writes only after these checks. All 19 current review files have nonempty distinct author/reviewer values.

question_articles.dart fails closed for non-accepted entries, malformed data, duplicate IDs, and unsafe/non-HTTPS source links; target and question lookup includes domain and exact revision. question_articles_test.dart includes exact-revision lookup, failure-closed decoder, mobile reader/open-pause/link placement, and absent-article tests. I did not execute tests/builds, as prohibited.

Root reports under genuine grants: initial stale check reproduced; build.py --write then --check passed 60; test_coverage.py two tests passed; Flutter question_articles_test.dart four tests passed; coverage refresh reported accepted 60/draft 87/missing 4208. This reviewer did not rerun those commands.
